name: ThresholD
author: Knots
description: Go between the spike, cube portal, and platform at 32% as the wave. Navigate through the following section as the wave until 35%, where you can then hold to the ceiling. Avoid the obstacles from 37% to 41%, then fall to the floor between the spikes and invisible platform at 42%. Stay at the floor until 96%, where you'll then need to hold for the rest of the level.
